seoDescription: HSE's currently published 2028–29 calendar lists Aug. 9, 2028, as the first student day and May 24, 2029, as the last student day. See break dates, graduations, the official PDF and calendar download.
heroSummary: HSE's currently published 2028–29 calendar lists Wednesday, August 9, 2028, as the first full day for all students and Thursday, May 24, 2029, as the last student day. Fall Break is October 16–20, Thanksgiving Break is November 22–24, Winter Break is December 21–January 2, and Spring Break is March 30–April 6.

customSections.label: What HSE Says About School Cancellations
customSections.content: The district calendar says virtual learning days will be used if school is canceled. It does not list preset weather make-up dates, so families should check current HSE messages when a cancellation occurs.

customSections.label: What Changed from 2027–28?

customSections.label: 2029 Graduation Dates for Fishers and HSE High Schools
customSections.content: The student year ends May 24, but the district calendar schedules the two high school ceremonies in early June.

sourceReviewSummary: Reviewed August 16, 2026, against HSE Schools' district calendars page and the currently published 2028–29 one-page PDF.
sourceReviewDetails: We reviewed the PDF currently linked from HSE's district calendars page and verified the dates shown on this page against it.
We checked the full calendar, including staff-only dates, grading-period endings, breaks, graduation dates, and the district's virtual-learning note.
The HSE PDF labels January 4 as “Frist Day after Winter Break.” This page corrects the spelling to “First Day” without changing the published date.

Return dates after Fall, Thanksgiving, and Spring Break are planning dates derived from the published break ranges. The January 4, 2029, return after Winter Break is printed directly on the HSE calendar.

calendarFaqs.q: When does HSE school start in 2028?
calendarFaqs.a: The HSE 2028–29 calendar lists Wednesday, August 9, 2028, as the first full day for all students.

calendarFaqs.q: When do HSE students return after winter break?
calendarFaqs.a: January 3 is a staff orientation and in-service half day. Students return Thursday, January 4, 2029.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for HSE in 2029?
calendarFaqs.a: The HSE 2028–29 calendar lists Thursday, May 24, 2029, as the last student day.

calendarFaqs.q: When are Fishers and HSE High School graduations in 2029?
calendarFaqs.a: Fishers High School graduation is June 6, 2029, and Hamilton Southeastern High School graduation is June 7, 2029.

calendarFaqs.q: What happens if HSE cancels school?
calendarFaqs.a: If HSE cancels school, the district calendar says virtual learning days will be used. Families should check current HSE messages for the day's plan.
